text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk after training,
my smartphone buzzed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a message from <support>!
Even in their casual words, I can feel
their warm thoughtfulness toward us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm replying anyway, I'll include an update
on how well <chrname> is doing.
I'm sure they'll be happy to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what's the best way to let
<support> know about <chrname>'s
recent progress...?
choice_data_list: Take a video of her training
Use the power of words! Express it in writing

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reached out to <chrname>
and brought up the idea about the photos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I met up with <chrname>,
took a few photos,
and sent them off to <support>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to ask <chrname> for permission
to film a video during our next training session!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll show <support>, who is always cheering
her on, just how energetic she is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I drafted a message, recalling how
<chrname> did during today's training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making sure everything comes across clearly
to <support>, who supports her so warmly!
